letter.subject: Your Arden sales tax license {{number}}
letter.body:
Dear {{owner_name}},

The Department of Revenue issued sales tax license {{number}} to {{business_name}} for {{location_address}}. Display it where customers can see it.

You are assigned to file monthly. Each month's return is due by the 20th of the following month, even if you made no sales. Returns and payments are filed online at revenue.arden.gov.example. The state rate is 6.25%.

An accountant or bookkeeper can file for you once you authorise them on the license's page.

notice.subject: Notice of non-filing: sales tax return for {{period}}
notice.body:
Dear {{owner}},

Our records show no sales tax return for {{period}} for {{record_name}}, license {{record}}. It was due {{due}}. The license is now delinquent.

File the return online at revenue.arden.gov.example, even if you had no sales; a zero return is still required. A late return is charged a penalty of 5% of the tax per month or part of a month late, up to 25%, and never less than $15.00. If returns remain unfiled, we may revoke the license and estimate the tax you owe.

lapse_letter.subject: Notice of license revocation: {{record}}
lapse_letter.body:
Dear {{owner}},

The return for {{period}} for {{record_name}} is still not filed, 120 days after it was due. Sales tax license {{record}} is revoked: you may not make taxable sales in Arden until every return is filed and the license is reinstated.
